subject: Cannot export data as CSV
description: I am trying to export my project data but I keep getting an error saying the format is unsupported.
resolution: Navigate to Settings > Data > Export and select CSV. If the option is greyed out, your current plan does not include bulk exports. Please upgrade to Pro or Enterprise, or contact support@acme-saas.com for assistance.

subject: Password reset email not received
description: I requested a password reset 30 minutes ago but have not received the email. I have checked my inbox multiple times.
resolution: Check your spam or junk folder first. Make sure you are using the exact email address registered to your account. Password reset links expire after 24 hours. If the issue persists, try from an incognito browser window or contact support.

subject: Internal: Refund processed outside policy window
description: Agent processed a full refund for a customer 45 days after purchase, which is outside our standard 30-day policy. This was caused by a billing system error that charged the customer twice.
resolution: Escalated to billing team lead. One-time exception approved due to billing system fault. Credit issued and confirmed by customer. Engineering ticket opened to prevent duplicate charges. Updated internal SOP to require billing team sign-off for out-of-policy refunds.

subject: How do I invite team members?
description: I just signed up and I cannot figure out how to add my colleagues to my workspace.
resolution: Go to Settings > Members > Invite. Enter each colleague's email address, choose their role (Admin, Member, or Viewer), and click Send Invite. They will receive an invitation email to accept. If they do not see it, ask them to check spam.

subject: Two-factor authentication code not accepted
description: My authenticator app shows a code but Acme SaaS says it is invalid every time I try to log in.
resolution: This is usually caused by a time sync issue on the device running your authenticator app. Make sure your phone's clock is set to automatic/network time. On iOS: Settings > General > Date & Time > Set Automatically. On Android: Settings > General Management > Date and Time > Automatic date and time. After syncing, try the code again. If the problem persists, use a backup code to log in and re-enroll your authenticator.

subject: API key giving 401 Unauthorized
description: I generated an API key and added it to my requests but every call returns 401 Unauthorized.
resolution: Make sure you are sending the key in the Authorization header exactly as: 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'. Note the space after 'Bearer'. Also check that the key has the correct scope — a read-only key cannot make write requests. If the key was recently regenerated the old key is immediately invalidated.

subject: Slack integration not sending notifications
description: I connected Slack but our team is not getting any notifications in the channel I configured.
resolution: First, verify the integration is still connected under Settings > Integrations > Slack. If it shows as disconnected, re-authorize it. Second, check that the Slack bot has been invited to the target channel (/invite @acme-saas in the channel). Third, confirm that notification events are toggled on in the Slack integration settings. Changes take effect immediately.

subject: Accidentally deleted a project
description: One of my team members deleted an important project by mistake. Is there any way to recover it?
resolution: Yes — deleted projects are soft-deleted for 30 days before permanent removal. Go to Settings > Deleted Projects, find the project, and click Restore. All tasks, comments, and attachments will be restored. If it has been more than 30 days, unfortunately recovery is not possible.

subject: How to set up SSO with Okta
description: We are an Enterprise customer and we want to configure SSO with Okta so our employees can use their company credentials.
resolution: Here is how to set up SAML SSO with Okta: 1. In Okta, create a new SAML 2.0 application. 2. In Acme SaaS, go to Settings > Security > Single Sign-On and copy the ACS URL and Entity ID. 3. Paste those into your Okta SAML settings. 4. Download the Okta IdP metadata XML and paste it back into Acme SaaS. 5. Click Test & Save. For a guided walkthrough, book a free setup call via support@acme-saas.com.

subject: Internal: Enterprise customer asking for HIPAA BAA
description: Enterprise customer HealthFlow Inc. is requesting a signed HIPAA Business Associate Agreement before they can go live.
resolution: Routed to legal@acme-saas.com. Standard BAA template sent to customer. Customer signed and returned. BAA filed in legal vault. Account flagged as HIPAA-enabled in the admin panel. Customer notified that PHI handling is now covered.

subject: Can I change the billing email address?
description: Our billing contact has left the company and we need to update the email address that receives invoices.
resolution: Go to Settings > Billing > Billing Contact and update the email address. The change takes effect for the next invoice. You can also download past invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices regardless of which email they were originally sent to.

subject: Dashboard loading very slowly on Firefox
description: The Acme SaaS dashboard loads fine on Chrome but takes over 30 seconds to become usable on Firefox.
resolution: We identified a performance issue with Firefox and the project list component in versions prior to Firefox 125. Please update Firefox to the latest version. If you are on the latest version and still experiencing this, try clearing your browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Del) and disabling browser extensions in a private window to rule out extension conflicts.

subject: How do task due date reminders work?
description: I set due dates on tasks but I am not getting any reminder notifications. Do reminders need to be enabled somewhere?
resolution: Due date reminders are sent by email 24 hours before a task is due, and again 1 hour before. Make sure email notifications are enabled under Profile > Notification Preferences. Also check that your email address is verified. If you prefer Slack reminders, connect the Slack integration and enable due date alerts in the Slack notification settings.

subject: Webhook endpoint receiving duplicate events
description: My webhook endpoint is receiving the same event two or three times for a single action. This is causing duplicate records in our system.
resolution: Webhooks may be delivered more than once in rare cases (network issues, retries). Your endpoint must be idempotent — use the event ID field in the payload to deduplicate. Store the event IDs you have processed and discard any duplicates. We include X-Acme-Event-Id in every webhook request for this purpose.

subject: How do I revoke a team member's access?
description: An employee just left the company and I need to immediately revoke their access to our workspace.
resolution: Go to Settings > Members, find the member, and click Remove. Their access is revoked immediately and they will be logged out of all active sessions within 60 seconds. If the member was an Admin, review any API keys or webhooks they may have created and rotate or delete them.

subject: GitHub integration not linking PRs to tasks
description: We set up the GitHub integration but pull requests are not automatically linking to tasks even though we are including the task ID in the PR title.
resolution: To link a PR to an Acme SaaS task, include the task ID in the format ACME-123 anywhere in the PR title or description. Make sure the task ID prefix matches your project prefix, which is set in Settings > Projects > [Project] > Settings > ID Prefix. Also confirm the GitHub app has been granted access to the relevant repositories in your GitHub organization settings.

subject: Can I have multiple workspaces under one account?
description: We have two separate business units that need isolated project spaces. Is it possible to have two workspaces with the same billing account?
resolution: Yes — Enterprise plans support multiple workspaces under a single billing account. Each workspace is fully isolated with its own members, projects, and settings. Contact sales@acme-saas.com to set this up. On Starter and Pro plans, a single workspace is included; you would need a second subscription for a second isolated workspace.

subject: Internal: Agent sent a draft reply without reviewing it
description: An agent accidentally clicked Send instead of Save Draft on an AI-drafted reply. The draft had low confidence and contained inaccurate pricing information that was sent to a Pro customer.
resolution: Customer was contacted immediately with an apology and correct pricing information. Refund of one month offered as goodwill gesture — customer accepted. Engineering opened a ticket to add a confirmation dialog for low-confidence drafts. Internal training reminder sent to all agents: always review the confidence score before sending.

subject: How to use the mobile app offline?
description: I travel frequently and I need to access my tasks without an internet connection. Does the mobile app support offline use?
resolution: Yes, the mobile app caches your most recently viewed projects and tasks automatically. Open the app while online to prime the cache. Offline, you can read tasks and add comments (they will sync when you reconnect). You cannot create new projects or upload attachments offline. For best results, open the app on WiFi before your trip to ensure the cache is warm.

subject: Want to cancel subscription and request a refund
description: I signed up three days ago and the product is not a good fit for our team. I would like to cancel and get a refund.
resolution: Refund approved — the account is within the 14-day free trial period and no charges have been made. Subscription cancelled and account closed as requested. Confirmation email sent. Data will be retained for 90 days and then permanently deleted. Customer was offered a 30-minute onboarding call first but declined.

subject: Rate limit hit on API — getting 429 errors
description: Our integration is hitting rate limits and getting 429 responses. We are on the Pro plan.
resolution: Pro plan allows 1,000 API requests per minute per API key. Check if you are batching requests correctly — many operations support bulk endpoints that count as a single request. Add exponential back-off with jitter when you receive a 429: wait 1 second, then 2, 4, 8 seconds. The Retry-After header in the 429 response tells you exactly when to retry.

subject: How do I set up a custom domain?
description: We are an Enterprise customer and we would like to serve the dashboard from our own domain.
resolution: Go to Settings > Custom Domain and enter your desired subdomain (e.g. work.yourcompany.com). We will provide a CNAME record — add it to your DNS. Once DNS propagates (5–30 minutes), click Verify and we will auto-provision a TLS certificate. You will also receive SPF/DKIM records for email branding. Need help? Book a setup call via support@acme-saas.com.

subject: Can I export data in JSON format for a migration?
description: We are moving to a different project management tool and we need to export all our data in a structured format.
resolution: Yes — go to Settings > Data > Export and select JSON. The export includes all projects, tasks, subtasks, comments, members, and metadata. Attachments are included as download URLs valid for 7 days. Enterprise customers can also request a GDPR-compliant full data export by emailing privacy@acme-saas.com.

subject: Notification emails going to spam
description: All notification emails from Acme SaaS are landing in our company's spam folder. This is affecting the entire team.
resolution: Ask your IT administrator to whitelist the domain acme-saas.com and the sending IP ranges we publish at acme-saas.com/email-ips. Also add noreply@acme-saas.com to the safe senders list. Enterprise customers with custom domains can configure SPF/DKIM records for their domain which significantly reduces spam scoring.

subject: Internal: Customer data visible to wrong tenant — potential data leak
description: Customer A reported seeing project names belonging to Customer B in their project list after a brief period. Incident started approximately 14:20 UTC.
resolution: Root cause: a caching bug introduced in deploy v2.41.0 caused tenant ID to be omitted from the project list cache key. Fix deployed in v2.41.1 at 15:05 UTC. Cache cleared across all regions. Affected customers notified per GDPR Article 33 within 72 hours. Post-mortem written and shared with engineering. Additional tenantId validation added to all data access layers as a defense in depth measure.

subject: How do I create subtasks?
description: I need to break down large tasks into smaller steps. Is there a subtask feature?
resolution: Yes — open any task and click Add Subtask at the bottom of the task panel. You can add as many subtasks as you need, assign them to different team members, and set individual due dates. The parent task shows a progress bar indicating how many subtasks are completed.

subject: Annual plan — when does it renew?
description: We are on an annual plan and I cannot find the renewal date anywhere in the dashboard.
resolution: Your renewal date is shown on the Settings > Billing page next to your current plan. You will also receive a renewal reminder email 30 days and 7 days before the renewal date. If you would like to cancel or change your plan before renewal, please do so at least 24 hours before the renewal date to avoid being charged for the next period.

subject: How to @mention teammates in comments?
description: I want to tag a specific team member in a task comment to get their attention. How does that work?
resolution: In any task comment, type @ followed by the person's name or email to mention them. A dropdown will appear with matching team members — click to select. They will receive an in-app notification and (if enabled) an email notification that they were mentioned.

subject: Zapier integration not triggering on task completion
description: I set up a Zap that should trigger when a task is marked complete in Acme SaaS but it never fires.
resolution: Re-authenticate the Acme SaaS connection in Zapier — OAuth tokens occasionally expire. Also check that the trigger is set to 'Task Completed' (not 'Task Updated') and that the connected Acme SaaS account has access to the project where tasks are being completed. Test the trigger in Zapier using a recent task completion event to verify the connection.

subject: Internal: Downtime post-mortem for April 23 incident
description: 15-minute partial outage on 2026-04-23 affecting project list API. Customers on EU region reported 503 errors.
resolution: Root cause: database connection pool exhaustion in EU region following a misconfigured deployment that doubled the connection count. Resolved by rolling back the deployment and increasing connection pool limits. 14 customers affected for 15 minutes. SLA credit issued automatically for Enterprise customers per policy. Runbook updated to include connection pool checks in deployment checklist.

subject: How to add a project description or README?
description: I would like to add a longer description or overview document to my project so new team members can get context.
resolution: Open your project and click the Description tab at the top. You can write rich text including headers, lists, code blocks, and links. The description is visible to all project members. Think of it as a lightweight README for your project.

subject: How do I filter tasks by assignee?
description: I manage a large project with many tasks and I need to quickly view only the tasks assigned to a specific person.
resolution: In the project task list, click the Filter button in the top toolbar and select Assignee. You can filter by one or multiple team members. The filter persists for the current session. You can also save custom views by clicking Save View — saved views appear in the left sidebar for quick access.

subject: Lost backup codes for 2FA
description: I lost access to my phone and I also cannot find my 2FA backup codes. I am completely locked out of my account.
resolution: For account recovery without 2FA backup codes, email support@acme-saas.com from your registered account email address with the subject 'Account Recovery Request'. We will ask you to verify your identity by answering security questions or by providing proof of account ownership. Once verified, we will disable 2FA so you can log in and re-enroll. Processing time is 1 business day.

subject: How does pricing work if we add more users mid-cycle?
description: We are on the Starter plan and we want to add two more users before our billing cycle ends. Will we be charged immediately?
resolution: Yes, adding users mid-cycle incurs a prorated charge for the remainder of the billing period. The charge is calculated as: (daily rate) x (days remaining in cycle) x (new users). The prorated amount is charged immediately and your next invoice will include the full cost for all users. You can preview the charge on the Settings > Billing page before confirming the upgrade.

subject: Internal: Agent accidentally removed wrong member from workspace
description: Support agent removed the account owner from an Enterprise workspace when trying to remove a different member. Owner is now locked out and cannot access billing.
resolution: Owner re-added by engineering team via admin console with full Owner role restored. Agent briefed — confirmed it was a UI mistake (names looked similar in the member list). UX improvement ticket filed to add a confirmation step when removing Owner-role accounts. No data was affected.

subject: Can tasks have multiple assignees?
description: Some of our tasks are shared between two people. Can I assign a task to more than one person?
resolution: Currently tasks support a single primary assignee. As a workaround, use @mentions in the task description or comments to loop in additional team members, and use subtasks to split responsibilities — each subtask can have its own assignee. Multi-assignee support is on our roadmap for Q3 2026.

subject: How to set up Jira two-way sync?
description: We use both Acme SaaS and Jira and we want changes in one system to reflect in the other.
resolution: Go to Settings > Integrations > Jira and connect your Atlassian account. Choose which Jira project and Acme SaaS project to sync. You can map Jira issue types to Acme SaaS task types. Two-way sync means: creating a task in either system creates it in the other; completing a task in either system marks it done in both. Note: comments sync is one-way (Jira to Acme SaaS only) due to Jira API limitations.

subject: How do I see the audit log of who changed what?
description: A task was modified and we need to know who made the change and when. Is there an audit log?
resolution: Yes — open the task and click the Activity tab. Every change to the task (title, description, assignee, due date, status, comments) is logged with the user and timestamp. For workspace-level changes (member additions, billing changes, settings), Admins can view the full audit log under Settings > Audit Log. Enterprise customers can export the audit log as CSV.

subject: Upgrade from Starter to Pro — how to preserve data?
description: We are currently on the Starter plan and we want to upgrade to Pro. Will all our existing data be preserved?
resolution: Yes, all data is preserved when upgrading. Go to Settings > Billing > Change Plan and select Pro. The upgrade takes effect immediately. Your existing projects, tasks, members, and integrations are all retained. You will immediately gain access to Pro features: additional members, unlimited knowledge sources, advanced reporting, and all channel integrations.

subject: OAuth connection to Google Calendar expired
description: The Google Calendar integration was working fine but stopped syncing due dates to my calendar last week.
resolution: Google OAuth tokens expire periodically and need to be re-authorized. Go to Settings > Integrations > Google Calendar and click Reconnect. You will be taken through the Google OAuth flow again. After re-authorizing, the integration will resume syncing. This typically happens every 6 months with Google OAuth.

subject: How to enable dark mode?
description: I prefer working in dark mode. Is that available in Acme SaaS?
resolution: Yes — dark mode is available. Go to Profile > Appearance and select Dark, Light, or System (follows your OS preference). The setting is saved per user and syncs across devices including the mobile app.

subject: Webhook signature verification failing
description: I am trying to verify the X-Acme-Signature header on incoming webhooks but my computed signature never matches.
resolution: Make sure you are computing the HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw request body bytes, not a parsed JSON object. Also use the webhook secret exactly as shown in Settings > API > Webhooks — it is case-sensitive and should not have any leading or trailing whitespace. In Node.js: crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody).digest('hex'). Compare with the signature value after stripping the 'sha256=' prefix.

subject: Internal: SLA credit dispute from Enterprise customer
description: Enterprise customer TechFlow Ltd is disputing a 4-hour outage on their account but our status page only shows 2 hours.
resolution: Investigated logs for TechFlow Ltd's region (EU). Confirmed actual downtime was 3h 47m due to a delayed recovery in their availability zone. Status page showed 2h due to a monitoring gap. SLA credit calculated on actual downtime: 10x credit per hour = 38x hourly rate ≈ $1,520 credit applied to their account. Customer satisfied. Monitoring gap reported to infrastructure team for remediation.

subject: How do I import tasks from a CSV spreadsheet?
description: We have a list of 200 tasks in a spreadsheet and we do not want to enter them one by one.
resolution: Go to your project and click Import > CSV. Download the import template to see the expected column format (Task Name, Assignee Email, Due Date, Priority, Description). Fill in your spreadsheet using that format, then upload the CSV. The import preview shows you how each row will be created before you confirm. Up to 1,000 rows per import.

subject: How to change task priority?
description: I cannot find where to set or change the priority level on a task.
resolution: Open the task and click the Priority dropdown (it shows None by default). Options are Urgent, High, Medium, and Low. You can also change priority in bulk from the project task list: select multiple tasks using the checkboxes, then click Bulk Edit > Priority.

subject: SSO login redirect loop
description: After setting up SAML SSO, users get stuck in a redirect loop when they try to log in. They are bounced between Acme SaaS and our identity provider repeatedly.
resolution: A redirect loop usually means the ACS URL or Entity ID is misconfigured in your IdP. Double-check: 1) The ACS URL in your IdP exactly matches what is shown in Settings > Security > SSO (no trailing slash difference). 2) The Entity ID matches exactly. 3) Your IdP is sending the NameID in email format. If using Okta, ensure the application is assigned to the user's Okta account. Use Settings > Security > SSO > Test Configuration to get a detailed error message.

subject: How do recurring tasks work?
description: Some of our tasks happen every week. Can I set a task to repeat automatically?
resolution: Yes — open a task and click the Recurrence option (calendar icon next to the due date). Choose the recurrence pattern: daily, weekly, monthly, or custom. When a recurring task is marked complete, a new instance is automatically created with the next due date. Subtasks and descriptions carry over; assignees do too unless you change them.

subject: Internal: Competitor pricing comparison request
description: Sales team needs a comparison of Acme SaaS pricing vs Asana and Monday.com for an Enterprise deal.
resolution: Competitor pricing sheet shared from internal Google Drive (link in ticket). Summary: Acme SaaS Enterprise is 15-20% cheaper than Asana Business and comparable to Monday.com Work OS Pro. Key differentiators to highlight: AI auto-resolve, built-in RAG knowledge base, Zendesk native integration. Sales deck updated with Q2 2026 pricing. Deal won — TechVentures signed 3-year Enterprise contract.

subject: How do I archive a completed project?
description: We finished a project and it is cluttering the main project list. Can I archive it without deleting it?
resolution: Yes — open the project, click the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top right, and select Archive Project. Archived projects are hidden from the main project list but all data is preserved. You can view and restore archived projects from Settings > Archived Projects at any time.

subject: How long are file attachments stored?
description: I uploaded several large files as task attachments. I want to know if they will be deleted automatically.
resolution: File attachments are stored for the lifetime of your subscription and are never automatically deleted while your account is active. If you delete the task or project containing the attachment, the file is soft-deleted and permanently removed after 30 days. On Starter plans, total attachment storage is capped at 5 GB. Pro and Enterprise plans include 100 GB and unlimited storage respectively.
